frame.modular: cell = the half low module (1.44 x 1.20 x 0.70). Whole = two halves side by side, tall = two lows stacked: same footprint, post positions, flat top and foot, and shelf heights. Posts 4 mm inside the bounds, iron bands flush with them, so the mod's bounding-box corner snap points stack and line up any two modules.

space.unity: prefab space, origin on the floor at the centre of the footprint, +z front, +y up, +x to the furniture's left seen from the front

fill_order: MIRROR grid order: index = grid_row * 8 + grid_col; grid_row 0 = the top shelf; each row left to right seen from the front. All 8 units of a shelf share one position.y, so the mod's GridOrder (rows of 8 by position.y descending, each by position.x descending) gives exactly this order.
position: unit position = bottom centre of its pile, 1 mm over the shelf top. box_size = [x, y, z] Unity, informational.
copy_rule: Each copy = one bar at TRUE SIZE: align (long axis -> +z, into the depth; thin axis -> up), then_rotate (a little yaw, the top bar sometimes turned end for end), fit_longest_m 0.6226 = the vanilla bar's own longest side, so scale 1.000; anchor bottom. Layer j sits at offset.y = j * 0.1249 m. 2 bars per unit, bottom first.

all_bars.note: Copper, Tin, Bronze, Iron, Silver, BlackMetal, Flametal and FlametalNew share one 44-triangle bar mesh
